path.description:
Path identifies the field, section, or artifact path associated with the
error.

message.description: Message is the human-readable explanation of the problem.

ErrorDetail.description:
ErrorDetail describes one machine-readable validation or execution problem in
a command result.

plan_path.description: PlanPath is the archived plan path associated with the evidence records.

pr_url.description: PRURL is the recorded pull request URL used for remote observation.

ci_record_id.description:
CIRecordID is the created CI evidence record identifier when CI was
refreshed.

sync_record_id.description:
SyncRecordID is the created sync evidence record identifier when sync was
refreshed.

EvidenceRefreshArtifacts.description:
EvidenceRefreshArtifacts lists evidence records touched by `harness evidence
refresh`.

ok.description: OK reports whether at least one evidence domain was refreshed.

command.description: Command is the stable command identifier for the result payload.

summary.description: Summary is the concise human-readable outcome description.

artifacts.description: Artifacts points to the evidence records created by the command.

refreshed.description:
Refreshed reports the machine-readable evidence statuses written by this
refresh.

oneOf.description: NextAction lists the most relevant follow-up steps in priority order.

next_actions.description: NextAction lists the most relevant follow-up steps in priority order.

warnings.description:
Warnings lists degraded domains that did not prevent other evidence from
being refreshed.

errors.description: Errors lists hard failures that prevented any evidence refresh.

EvidenceRefreshResult.description:
EvidenceRefreshResult is the JSON result returned by `harness evidence
refresh`.

ci_status.description: CIStatus is the CI evidence status written by this refresh.

sync_status.description: SyncStatus is the sync evidence status written by this refresh.

EvidenceRefreshStatuses.description:
EvidenceRefreshStatuses lists the compact evidence statuses written by
`harness evidence refresh`.

oneOf.description:
Command is the suggested command line to run next when the next step is
best expressed as a harness command.

command.description:
Command is the suggested command line to run next when the next step is
best expressed as a harness command.

description.description: Description explains the suggested next step in plain language.

NextAction.description:
NextAction describes one concrete follow-up action that the caller should
consider after reading a command result.
